name: Speak with Shoni
summary: Alliance travelers in Ironforge are sent south to find Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind. She leads an underground assault unit preparing to support the effort to reclaim Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Call from Tinkertown
sections.body: After Gnomeregan fell to radiation, surviving gnomes made an exile quarter in Ironforge. Engineers, tinkers, and strategists there keep planning how to breach their lost home. Central planning remains in Tinkertown, but preparations reach far beyond Khaz Modan. Adventurers in the mountain city are directed south to Stormwind, where specialized military hardware is being prepared for fighting underground.

sections.title: Subterranean Ambitions
sections.body: Shoni the Shilent commands an elite underground assault crew in Stormwind's Dwarven District, among its anvils and forges. Her sappers need gyrodrillmatic excavationators to burrow toward sectors held by troggs. The Deeprun Tram now links Ironforge directly to Stormwind beneath the mountains, making the journey to Shoni straightforward.

faq.answer: Shoni the Shilent is a gnomish officer in Stormwind City. She commands an underground assault unit building and deploying heavy excavation gear to help retake Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Where can I find Shoni the Shilent?
faq.answer: Shoni is in Stormwind City's Dwarven District, near the blacksmithing trainers and forges, just steps from the Deeprun Tram terminal.

faq.q: How do I get to Stormwind from Ironforge?
faq.answer: The fastest way from Ironforge to Stormwind is the Deeprun Tram, on the northeastern side of Tinkertown. It carries travelers straight to Stormwind's Dwarven District beneath the mountains.

faq.q: What does Shoni need help with?
faq.answer: Shoni is outfitting an underground assault crew and needs components for her gyrodrillmatic excavationators. The effort eventually sends adventurers to Westfall and the Deadmines.

faq.q: Is this quest required to get Underground Assault?
faq.answer: No. This is an optional breadcrumb. You can go straight to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and speak with Shoni to take up Underground Assault.

faq.q: How does this connect to Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Gnomish leaders are gathering forces and excavation technology to breach Gnomeregan's defenses. Shoni's team is developing the underground drills needed to break into the contaminated city.

angles.text: As a gnome in Ironforge, you can help reclaim your irradiated home by following Shoni's orders and joining the effort to retake Gnomeregan.
As an engineer, you can see Shoni's project calls for gyrodrillmatic excavationators, complex gnomish machines built for deep-earth tunneling.
As an Alliance traveler, you can use the Deeprun Tram to move personnel between Ironforge and Stormwind.
